title: HortiApi use-case profile
description: Describes one business scenario on top of the generic HortiApi schema: which steps exist and, per step, which fields are read (request) or filled (response). Fields that are not listed are ignored by the server.

id.description: Resource identifier of the use-case. The value equals the file name of the profile. A breaking change gets a new use-case with a numbered suffix, for example `direct-debit-2`.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the scenario.

hortiapi.description: HortiApi schema versions this profile applies to.

docs.description: Page with the narrative description of the use-case.

steps.description: The steps of the workflow, keyed by step id. The first step is the entry point.

open.description: Open questions about this profile. Remove when answered.

actor.description: client: an API call made by the client. server: something that happens on the server without a call.

level.description: core: needed for a minimal client implementation. extended: optional for a client. A server that declares the use-case supports both.

operationId.description: operationId of the operation in the HortiApi schema.

call.description: Method and path of `operationId`, repeated for readability.

extends.description: Step whose operation and request/response fields are inherited. Fields listed here are added or overridden.

when.description: Precondition for this step, for example a required state.

after.description: This step can be done at any time after the named step.

parameters.description: Path and query parameters of the operation, keyed by name.

request.description: Fields of the request body the server reads.

response.description: Fields of the response body the client can rely on.

errors.description: Errors specific to this use-case. Generic errors (401, 500, ...) are not listed.

trigger.description: What makes the server perform this step.

after.description: This step can happen at any time after the named step.

changes.description: What the client sees changed afterwards.

from.description: State before the step. Omit when the step can happen from any state.

next.description: Steps that can follow this step.

fields.description: Fields keyed by path, relative to the request or response model. `[]` marks an array, for example `lines[].price.amount.value`.

usage.description: required: must be present. optional: used when present. conditional: required under the condition in `when`. not-used: deliberately not part of this use-case, covers the whole object.

value.description: The fixed value of this field in this use-case.

values.description: The values this field can have in this use-case.

description.description: Business meaning of the field in this use-case.

constraint.description: Restriction on the value, for example a maximum length.

resources.description: Entries of a resources array, keyed by resource key `target/name`.

features.description: Entries of a features array, keyed by feature type, for example the VBN code `S20`.

references.description: Entries of a references array, keyed by reference name, for example `VN`.

entry.description: One keyed entry of a resources, features or references array.

mapping.description: Where this field is found in another format, keyed by format name. For example the column number in the AI2 file.

when.description: Situation in which this error is returned.

proposed.description: True while the error type has no documentation page yet.
